answer_1.quote: The implicature utterances are completely generated by LLMs ... We propose prompting strategies to generate evaluation data with ChatGPT ...
answer_1.outputs: Negation utterances and implicature utterances generated for evaluation and augmentation

answer_2.quote: We first employ automatic metrics to understand the generated data. To achieve this, we use training set as reference and calculate BLEU , ROUGE-L , METEOR  and BertScore .

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation centered around two questions: (1) "Can the utterance imply the intent?" (2) "If yes, is it conveyed explicitly?" 8 human annotators from our internal team (with fluent English skills) provided binary answers.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators answer two binary questions: whether the utterance can imply the intent, and if so whether the intent is conveyed explicitly.
